1. **`PreMailer.Net/Html/EmailHtmlMarkupFormatter.cs` — `CloseTag` override breaks void elements.** The override ignores the `selfClosing` parameter entirely and always emits a full closing tag. For void elements (`
`, ``, `
`, ``, ``, ``, ``, ``, ``, ``, etc.) this will now emit invalid markup like `
` or `` instead of leaving them unclosed/self-closing. This is worse than the bug being fixed and will corrupt real emails containing images/line breaks. Fix: only force a closing tag for non-void elements; preserve the base/self-closing behavior for void elements (e.g. check `element.Flags`/a void-element set before deciding). 2. **`PreMailer.cs` — `GetMarkupFormatterForDocType()` now silently changes the documented default.** README states `preserveEntities` defaults to `false` and only preserves entities when explicitly requested, but this change makes the default formatter (used whenever `preserveEntities == false`) also rewrite `©`/`®`/etc. back to entities. That's a public, undocumented behavior change for every existing caller who didn't ask for entity preservation. Fix: keep empty-tag preservation independent of entity preservation — don't fold entity rewriting into the default formatter; only apply it when `preserveEntities` is true (or explicitly document/decide this is now always-on behavior and update README + changelog accordingly). 3. **`EmailHtmlMarkupFormatter.Text` — entity handling duplicates and diverges from `PreserveEntitiesHtmlMarkupFormatter` instead of reusing it.** The PR description claims it "combines functionality from the existing `PreserveEntitiesHtmlMarkupFormatter`" but instead reimplements a hardcoded 11-entry dictionary with `string.Replace`. This leaves two separate, inconsistent entity-preservation implementations in the codebase (one used when `preserveEntities=true`, a different weaker one used by default), and the hardcoded list misses the vast majority of HTML entities (e.g. `…`, `—`, ` `, `’`, accented letters). Fix: have `EmailHtmlMarkupFormatter` compose/derive from `PreserveEntitiesHtmlMarkupFormatter`'s existing entity logic (e.g. inherit from it and only override `CloseTag`) rather than hand-rolling a subset. 4. **Missing test coverage for void/self-closing elements.** The PR adds tests for `` and `©` but none for `
`, ``, or other void elements — exactly the case most likely to regress given issue #1. Fix: add a test asserting `
`/`` still serialize correctly (not as `
`/``) after this change. 5. **`PreMailer.cs` — flag/formatter interaction is now inconsistent.** With the change, `preserveEntities=false` routes through `EmailHtmlMarkupFormatter` (partial entity preservation + empty-tag preservation), while `preserveEntities=true` routes through plain `PreserveEntitiesHtmlMarkupFormatter` (full entity preservation, but no empty-tag preservation, reintroducing the original #171 bug when a caller explicitly opts into entity preservation). Fix: unify so empty-tag preservation always applies regardless of the `preserveEntities` flag, and entity preservation behavior is consistent whichever formatter class is used.
